bio.summary: Hani Jamjoom is a Principal Research Scientist and Manager at IBM T. J. Watson Research Center, leading a group on cloud and system security (confidential AI computing, agentic security, supply chain integrity). Earlier roles included leading Software-defined Data Governance work in IBM's Watson Data Platform and managing the Next Generation Platforms group. The PhD in computer science and engineering from the University of Michigan focused on intelligent controls in networks and operating systems.
notable: Member of the IBM Academy of Technology

people.name: Haining Wang

website.source_note: Virginia Tech ECE faculty profile (Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=tmOInzMAAAAJ)

people.current_position: Professor, Bradley Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Virginia Tech (Arlington, VA)

bio.summary: Haining Wang is a Professor in the Bradley Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Virginia Tech, based at the Virginia Tech Research Center in Arlington. Research covers cybersecurity, networking systems, cloud computing and cyber-physical systems. The PhD was earned at the University of Michigan in 2003, and IEEE Fellow status was granted in 2020 for contributions to network and cloud security.

people.name: Padmanabhan (Babu) Pillai
people.current_position: Associate Teaching Professor, Computer Science Department, Carnegie Mellon University

bio.summary: Padmanabhan (Babu) Pillai is an Associate Teaching Professor in Computer Science at Carnegie Mellon University, previously a Senior Research Engineer at Intel Labs. A systems researcher, work centers on distributed, interactive systems, operating systems, real-time and embedded systems, power management and edge computing (cloudlets). The PhD was completed at the University of Michigan under Kang Shin in the Real-Time Computing Lab.
notable: Senior Research Engineer, Intel Labs (2003 onward)

people.current_position: Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Iowa State University

bio.summary: Daji Qiao is a Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Iowa State University. Research areas are computing and networking systems, wireless networking and mobile computing, sensor networks and the Internet of Things, and cyber security. The PhD in electrical engineering (systems) is from the University of Michigan, following an MS from Ohio State University and a BE from Tsinghua University.
